reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend like getUpcomingDates, but parses days with ad-hoc new Date(`${start}T12:00:00`) instead of monthUtils.parseDate and re-decides the daily-skip rule that getNextDate already encodes.

duplication.why: The skipWeekend / daily-skip / move decision is written again here alongside the inline version in shared getNextDate and the move-only version in getUpcomingDates; the RSchedule + breadcrumb scaffolding mirrors getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: A new handler next to getUpcomingDates in the schedules app, registered the same way, consistent with the tree.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration, type import and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Readable and compact, but the weekend policy (skip for daily, move otherwise) now lives in a third place, so a change to it must be repeated.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend moves go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend from shared/schedules; only the date parsing sidesteps monthUtils.parseDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip branch is a small independent restatement of the rule, not a disguised copy of existing code.
